questions.question: What are two phrases you would actually use to start this skill?
questions.why: Real phrases become positive trigger tests.

questions.question: What similar request should stay outside this skill?
questions.why: A clear boundary prevents accidental launches.

questions.question: What should the skill hand back at the end?
questions.why: A named result helps measure if it finished.

exit_criteria: Record when the skill should start, stay inactive, and ask for confirmation.

questions.question: In which assistant should this first work?
questions.why: The host determines the skill packaging.

questions.question: Which operating systems should we plan to test?
questions.why: Install paths and commands vary by system.

questions.question: Should the skill belong to one project or to your whole account?
questions.why: The scope determines who can invoke it.

exit_criteria: Confirm supported hosts, systems and local installation boundaries.

questions.question: What should the skill remember between sessions?
questions.why: The profile only needs persistent values.

questions.question: Which information must stay on your machine?
questions.why: This sets a boundary for tools and network requests.

questions.question: How should you correct or remove a remembered value?
questions.why: The user needs control of their stored information.

questions.question: Which sites can receive a search, and which details can appear in it?
questions.why: Each site needs a clear limit on what it receives.

exit_criteria: Identify required profile data and explicit network and retention limits.

questions.question: What is the first part of the task that follows the same rule every time?
questions.why: This separates predictable work from decisions.

questions.question: Which tools can it use, and which tools should stay off limits?
questions.why: Access should match the actual job.

questions.question: Which action should always ask you before it runs?
questions.why: That keeps one-way changes under your control.

exit_criteria: Specify user stops, tools and the visible result for each automatic step.

questions.question: What real request should produce the expected final output?
What request should it safely turn down?
questions.why: This checks the boundary of the skill.

questions.question: If the session stops halfway, what evidence should it use to pick up?
questions.why: Resume should avoid repeating completed work.

exit_criteria: Provide should-trigger, should-not-trigger, refusal and resume test cases.
